keyCharacteristics: One shared globe and map across exploration and cinematic stories.
Neutral interface chrome; scientific colors retain their source meaning.
One source-aware invitation for a new visit; Continue for a returning visit.
Curated highlights with the complete catalogue available through search and View all.
Source-grounded endings and shared moments that preserve their starting position.

rules.name: Shared scene continuity
rules.body: Camera changes must not recreate the scene or source subscriptions. Preserve interruptible story framing, reduced motion and synchronous still capture.

rules.name: Source-aware discovery
rules.body: Recent radar requires a scan less than half an hour old; otherwise offer an available aurora forecast or a recorded Argo profile. Never imply local rain or aurora visibility.

rules.name: Honest completion
rules.body: Distinguish measured observations, reconstructions, forecasts and illustrative motion. Float Dive derives its conclusion from the selected samples.

dos: Keep the landing diagrams; use compact text categories inside Explore.
Keep Saved & recent and From today’s feeds directly discoverable; keep guided journeys and archives secondary.
Preserve the visitor’s camera, projection, category, query, scroll and focus when returning from a story.
Keep rounded location optional to override; existing shared views and deliberate camera movement take priority.
Adapt high-density drawing under sustained load while retaining scientific content and marker sizes.
donts: Saturated interface accents, accent glows, pure black, serif typography or emoji.
Globe rotation outside the controlled Earth landing view, perpetual interface loops or bouncing exploration cues.
Photographic Earth textures, decorative cloud layers or night-light overlays.
Proportional figures in updating numbers, clipped names or horizontal page overflow.
Spinners hiding the product, or blanking good data because another source failed.
Mandatory accounts/API keys or a setup page before the first useful frame.
Unexplained bare magnitudes, hidden deduplication or inaccurate coverage/liveness.
Relationships fabricated between observations, or pins lost on a feed refresh.
Performance claims without the hardware and measurement conditions.
